integrity: The recent source claim was checked in the primary arXiv PDF. The counterexamples and the cyclic/reversal symmetry boundary were checked in published pretzel-knot literature. The bundled computation verifies only finite permutation-orbit bookkeeping and is not used as proof of nonisotopy.
scientific_limitations: This finding corrects the blanket general-pretzel isotopy assertion in Theorem 13. It does not claim that every non-dihedral reordering changes knot type, and it does not re-audit the downstream quandle-coloring formulas. Unitary parameters can admit additional flype symmetries.
title: Arbitrary parameter permutation is not an isotopy symmetry of general pretzel knots
